limitations: All 32 episodes used for development; no held-out claims.
Simulated replay depth; 180 selected key frames, not continuous video.
Surface FP is a proxy, not executed contact or permission-builder output.
Phase accuracy is pooled frames; paired differences are episode means.

Phase height is centroid z minus a floor-dominated support median, not table-relative height.
No new rollout, policy inference, or simulation is run in this audit.
